inputs.name: Finite Hilbert class field and Artin reciprocity
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Class Field Theory
inputs.accepted_statement: The maximal finite abelian extension unramified at finite places and split at real places is the Hilbert class field, with Galois group the ordinary ideal class group under Artin.
inputs.exact_specialization: BR4: the locally constant homomorphism z|G_F has finite image inside the original arbitrary field k, hence cuts out an actual finite unramified abelian extension of the same F=Q(mu_N) inside Omega. F is totally complex for N>2. The original map therefore factors through Cl(F); conjugation carries arithmetic Frobenius at a prime to arithmetic Frobenius at the conjugate prime, fixing the inverse orientation in BR.33.

inputs.name: Finite cyclotomic Galois identification
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Section 6, basic results on cyclotomic extensions
inputs.accepted_statement: For M>0, Gal(Q(mu_M)/Q) is (Z/M)^× via zeta->zeta^a. Its automorphisms extend to the specified algebraic closure. Q(mu_M) is totally complex for M>2.
inputs.exact_specialization: BR5 realizes a nontrivial character value on the original G_Q, and identifies the mod-l cyclotomic character with the exponent on mu_l when l divides N. BR7 lifts the same CRT unit modulo l*f*2^n in the original Omega; it acts trivially on mu_l but by -1 under both product characters.

previously_reconstructed_inputs.used_scope: Only the principal-ideal identity for theta_(N,r), 1<=r<N, on every ideal of the actual cyclotomic field. Norm/distribution assertions and the later Kolyvagin system are not used.
previously_reconstructed_inputs.new_transfer: BR4 extends the theta relation to arbitrary positive a coprime to N, identifies twice the Eone group-ring element with -sigma_a^-1 theta_a, and divides by 2 only after mapping to the actual odd-characteristic k.

foundational_background: Finite group orders, elementary valuations and ideal factorization in a DVR
The ultrametric norm on the specified algebraic closure of Q_l and integrality of a module-finite algebra
Compactness of profinite Galois groups and the finite-image consequence of a locally constant function
The Chinese remainder theorem, finite geometric sums and Frobenius in characteristic l
not_assumed: LemmaX, CorX, or residual Bernoulli-unit vanishing
Any general Stickelberger ideal-class annihilation theorem
A prescribed Bernoulli-unit or nonvanishing theorem
An Iwasawa main theorem, Kato theorem, automorphy or rigidity
Finiteness or algebraic closedness of the original k
